name: Oscar Flinch
description: Stowaway who knows the location of the golden city.

timeline.summary: Thorn takes the Salty Dog and finds the stowaway Oscar Flinch halfway down the plank.
timeline.quote: he found someone already halfway down the plank: a stowaway named Oscar Flinch.

timeline.summary: Flinch tells of his old vessel being taken by a snake-haired woman seeking the golden city; intrigued, Thorn takes him aboard the Dire.
timeline.quote: Captain Thorn took Flinch back with him to the Dire

citation.text: "Brandis Thorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thorn leads an expedition into the heart of Ixalan using Flinch's knowledge of the golden city.
timeline.quote: Captain Thorn is using Flinch's piecemeal knowledge of the location of the golden city to lead an expedition into the heart of Ixalan.
